modeling_scope: Direct calls, including direct tail calls, use exact targets; table calls use static element candidates. Reference-call targets and dynamic table contents are not solved. Imported/exported tables, runtime writes and explicit initializers are conservatively diagnosed, even with static candidates. Element references are conservative roots, including private, passive and declarative segments. graph_complete means no gaps detected within this scope, not full Wasm certification. RETAINED sums dominated encoded function bytes within the current graph/root model. It does not predict recompiled file reduction or whole-file gzip savings, even when --strict passes.
measurement_scope: Raw and whole-file gzip deltas measure only these supplied artifacts. Gzip uses bikallem/compress defaults, not a measured network transfer. Function/package differences use encoded bytes and best-effort symbol identity. Build declarations do not prove controlled conditions or behavioral equivalence.
